question: How many countries and territories does the graph hold?
paraphrases: How many countries are in the health systems graph?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country) RETURN count(c) AS countries

question: How many capacity assessments are recorded?
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse) RETURN count(e) AS assessments

question: Which IHR core capacities does SPAR score?
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse) RETURN DISTINCT e.capacity_code AS code, e.capacity_name AS capacity ORDER BY code

question: Which years do the scored assessments cover, and how many are there per year?
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.year IS NOT NULL RETURN e.year AS year, count(e) AS assessments ORDER BY year

question: What is the name of the country with ISO code {iso}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {iso_code: $iso}) RETURN c.name AS country

question: What did {iso} score on each capacity in {year}?
paraphrases: Show the SPAR profile of a country for one year.
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {iso_code: $iso})-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.year = $year RETURN e.capacity_code AS code, e.capacity_name AS capacity, e.score AS score ORDER BY code

question: How has {iso}'s average capacity score changed across years?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {iso_code: $iso})-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.year IS NOT NULL RETURN e.year AS year, round(avg(e.score)) AS avg_score ORDER BY year

question: What is the global average score for each capacity in {year}?
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.year = $year RETURN e.capacity_code AS code, e.capacity_name AS capacity, round(avg(e.score)) AS avg_score ORDER BY code

question: Which capacity is weakest worldwide on average?
paraphrases: Where are countries least prepared, by capacity?
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.year IS NOT NULL RETURN e.capacity_name AS capacity, round(avg(e.score)) AS avg_score ORDER BY avg_score ASC, capacity LIMIT 3

question: Which capacity is strongest worldwide on average?
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.year IS NOT NULL RETURN e.capacity_name AS capacity, round(avg(e.score)) AS avg_score ORDER BY avg_score DESC, capacity LIMIT 3

question: Which countries have the lowest average capacity score in {year}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.year = $year RETURN c.name AS country, round(avg(e.score)) AS avg_score ORDER BY avg_score ASC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which countries have the highest average capacity score in {year}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.year = $year RETURN c.name AS country, round(avg(e.score)) AS avg_score ORDER BY avg_score DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: How many countries scored 100 on {code} in {year}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(e:EmergencyResponse {capacity_code: $code}) WHERE e.year = $year AND e.score = 100 RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS countries

question: Which countries reported a score of 0 on any capacity, and on which?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.year IS NOT NULL AND e.score = 0 RETURN c.name AS country, e.capacity_code AS code, e.year AS year ORDER BY country, code, year

question: Which countries scored below {threshold} on {code} in 2023?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(e:EmergencyResponse {capacity_code: $code}) WHERE e.year = 2023 AND e.score < $threshold RETURN c.name AS country, e.score AS score ORDER BY score, country

question: Which countries have no capacity assessment at all?
paraphrases: Which territories are missing from SPAR?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country) WHERE NOT (c)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-() RETURN c.name AS country ORDER BY country

question: How many countries were assessed in one, two or all three years?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.year IS NOT NULL WITH c, count(DISTINCT e.year) AS years RETURN years, count(c) AS countries ORDER BY years

question: Which countries were assessed in only one year, and which?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.year IS NOT NULL WITH c, collect(DISTINCT e.year) AS years WHERE size(years) = 1 RETURN c.name AS country, years[0] AS year ORDER BY country

question: Which countries improved their average score most between 2021 and 2023?
paraphrases: Who made the largest preparedness gains over the period?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(a:EmergencyResponse) WHERE a.year = 2021 WITH c, avg(a.score) AS s21 MATCH (c)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(b:EmergencyResponse) WHERE b.year = 2023 WITH c, s21, avg(b.score) AS s23 RETURN c.name AS country, round(s23 - s21) AS gain ORDER BY gain DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which countries' average score fell most between 2021 and 2023?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(a:EmergencyResponse) WHERE a.year = 2021 WITH c, avg(a.score) AS s21 MATCH (c)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(b:EmergencyResponse) WHERE b.year = 2023 WITH c, s21, avg(b.score) AS s23 RETURN c.name AS country, round(s23 - s21) AS change ORDER BY change ASC, country LIMIT 10

question: For each capacity in 2023, how wide is the gap between the best and worst country?
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.year = 2023 RETURN e.capacity_code AS code, min(e.score) AS lowest, max(e.score) AS highest, max(e.score) - min(e.score) AS spread ORDER BY spread DESC, code

question: Which countries have the most uneven capacity profile in 2023 (largest gap between their best and worst capacity)?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.year = 2023 WITH c, max(e.score) - min(e.score) AS gap RETURN c.name AS country, gap ORDER BY gap DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which countries scored at least {floor} on every scored capacity in 2023?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.year = 2023 WITH c, min(e.score) AS weakest WHERE weakest >= $floor RETURN c.name AS country, weakest ORDER BY weakest DESC, country

question: How has the global average for {code} moved year by year?
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse {capacity_code: $code}) WHERE e.year IS NOT NULL RETURN e.year AS year, round(avg(e.score)) AS avg_score, count(e) AS countries ORDER BY year

question: How many countries scored higher than {iso} on average in 2023?
cypher: MATCH (me:Country {iso_code: $iso})-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(m:EmergencyResponse) WHERE m.year = 2023 WITH avg(m.score) AS mine MATCH (c:Country)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.year = 2023 WITH mine, c, avg(e.score) AS theirs WHERE theirs > mine RETURN count(c) AS ahead

question: How many C1 (Policy) records carry no assessment year?
paraphrases: Data check: are C1 records missing their year?
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse {capacity_code: 'C01'}) WHERE e.year IS NULL RETURN count(e) AS undated

question: How many capacity assessments does {iso} have on record?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {iso_code: $iso})-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(e:EmergencyResponse) RETURN count(e) AS assessments

question: Which countries have names starting with {prefix}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country) WHERE c.name STARTS WITH $prefix RETURN c.name AS country, c.iso_code AS iso ORDER BY country

question: Which countries scored highest on {code} in 2023?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(e:EmergencyResponse {capacity_code: $code}) WHERE e.year = 2023 RETURN c.name AS country, e.score AS score ORDER BY score DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: How are the 2023 capacity scores distributed across bands of 20 points?
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.year = 2023 RETURN (e.score / 20) * 20 AS band, count(e) AS assessments ORDER BY band

question: What is the population of each country?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country) WHERE c.population IS NOT NULL RETURN c.name AS country, c.population AS population

question: How much did each country spend on emergency preparedness?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]-(e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.budget IS NOT NULL RETURN c.name AS country, sum(e.budget) AS spend

question: What were the SPAR scores in 2019?
paraphrases: How prepared were countries before COVID-19?
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse) WHERE e.year = 2019 RETURN e.capacity_code AS code, avg(e.score) AS avg_score
